chunks: In the name of Allah, the Most Gracious, the Most Merciful.

Muhammad ibn Ali ibn al-Husayn ibn Musa ibn Babawayh al-Qummi, the author of this book—may Allah, Exalted is He, have mercy on him—says: Clarification of the transmission routes of al-Saduq, may Allah have mercy on him, to those from whom he narrated through intermediaries.

key_terms.بَيَانُ طُرُقِ الصَّدُوقِ: A clarification of al-Saduq’s chains or routes of transmission.
key_terms.بِسْمِ اللَّهِ الرَّحْمٰنِ الرَّحِيمِ: The opening basmalah invoking Allah at the beginning of the text.
key_terms.مُصَنِّفُ هٰذَا الْكِتَابِ: The author and compiler of this book.

ai.seo_question: What does the prelude of Man La Yahduruhu al-Faqih say about al-Saduq’s transmission routes?
ai.summary: This is the opening prelude to the work, beginning with the basmalah and identifying the author as Muhammad ibn Ali ibn al-Husayn ibn Musa ibn Babawayh al-Qummi. It introduces a section explaining al-Saduq’s transmission routes to authorities from whom he narrated through intermediaries, reflecting the scholarly concern for documenting hadith transmission.
